title: Open-World RPG Environment Concept
summary: Environment concept prompt for a traversable RPG region with landmarks, faction territory, quest hooks, and encounter readability.
prompt: Create concept art for {argument name="game_title" default="Ashen Vale"}, an open-world RPG region. Show a playable valley with three readable landmarks, a safe player approach, enemy patrol lanes, hidden reward pockets, traversal shortcuts, and faction architecture. Include camera-friendly foreground, midground, and horizon composition for third-person exploration. Color language should support biome identity, danger level, healing safety, and quest focus. Avoid generic scenic wallpaper; every visible element must imply a gameplay purpose.
